items.name: Mounting Bracket
items.description: A flat L- or U-shaped bracket with configurable length, width, thickness, hole diameter, and hole spacing.
items.prompt: Build123d parametric mounting bracket with length 80 mm, width 40 mm, thickness 3 mm, two M4 mounting holes centered on each side, and 2 mm fillets on all edges. Export STL and STEP.

items.name: Base Plate
items.description: A rectangular plate with optional grid mounting holes and corner fillets.
items.prompt: Build123d rectangular base plate 120 mm x 80 mm x 5 mm with a 4x3 grid of M3 mounting holes on 20 mm spacing and 3 mm corner fillets. Export STL and STEP.

items.name: Square Beam
items.description: A simple extruded square or rectangular beam with configurable cross-section and length.
items.prompt: Build123d square aluminum beam 20 mm x 20 mm cross-section and 200 mm length with hollow center 16 mm x 16 mm. Export STL and STEP.

items.name: GT2 Pulley
items.description: A 20-tooth GT2 timing pulley with configurable bore diameter, hub size, and belt flange.
items.prompt: Build123d GT2 timing pulley with 20 teeth, pitch 2 mm, bore 5 mm, hub diameter 16 mm, hub width 8 mm, total width 7 mm, and 1 mm belt flanges. Export STL and STEP.

items.name: Rigid Shaft Coupler
items.description: A cylindrical coupler with two set-screw holes for joining two shafts.
items.prompt: Build123d rigid shaft coupler 25 mm outer diameter, 30 mm length, 5 mm through-bore, and two perpendicular M3 set-screw holes. Export STL and STEP.

items.name: Bushing Spacer
items.description: A cylindrical spacer or bushing with configurable inner and outer diameters and length.
items.prompt: Build123d bushing spacer with outer diameter 10 mm, inner diameter 5 mm, and length 8 mm. Export STL and STEP.

items.name: Split Electronics Enclosure
items.description: A two-part box with lid, mounting bosses, and ventilation slots.
items.prompt: Build123d split electronics enclosure bottom shell 100 mm x 60 mm x 30 mm wall thickness 2 mm, four M3 mounting bosses in corners 4 mm diameter 6 mm tall, and ventilation slots on one long side. Export STL and STEP.

items.name: 40 mm Fan Shroud
items.description: A shroud or duct adapter for a standard 40 mm cooling fan.
items.prompt: Build123d 40 mm cooling fan shroud with mounting pattern 32 mm x 32 mm for M3 screws, central 38 mm airflow hole, and 5 mm tall duct wall. Export STL and STEP.

items.name: PCB Standoff
items.description: A stackable PCB spacer with M3 internal thread clearance.
items.prompt: Build123d PCB standoff spacer 5 mm outer diameter, 10 mm height, with 3.2 mm through-hole for M3 screw and a small lip at top. Export STL and STEP.

items.name: Parallel Gripper Jaw
items.description: A single jaw for a parallel-jaw gripper with a V-groove and mounting holes.
items.prompt: Build123d parallel gripper jaw 50 mm x 20 mm x 10 mm with a 45 degree V-groove on the gripping face, two M2 mounting holes on the back face, and 2 mm fillets. Export STL and STEP.

items.name: Wheel Hub
items.description: A hub for attaching a wheel to a motor shaft with set-screw and bolt pattern.
items.prompt: Build123d wheel hub with 6 mm bore, 30 mm outer diameter, 10 mm height, four M3 bolt holes on 20 mm PCD, and a perpendicular M3 set-screw hole. Export STL and STEP.

items.name: Camera Mount
items.description: A swivel camera mount with a fixed base, pivot hole, and strap slot.
items.prompt: Build123d camera mount with 40 mm x 30 mm base, 2 mm wall thickness, 6 mm pivot hole centered, and a 20 mm wide strap slot. Export STL and STEP.
